items.title: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
items.summary: Raghad and Raad's family had to flee their home on foot because of the fighting between pro-government forces and the Houthis.

items.title: Race to update services' computer systems after cyber-security flaw found
items.summary: Websites were taken offline after the developers of programming language PHP said "critical vulnerabilities" had been discovered.

items.title: Trump ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit
items.summary: Trump is suing the BBC over an episode of Panorama that edited together two different sections of a speech he gave in 2021.

items.title: Trump says Musk has restored access to Ukraine's Starlink network
items.summary: Ukraine relies on Starlink for a range of military uses - its owner Elon Musk has repeatedly denied restricting access.

items.title: Crowd of 50 beats foreigner to death in South Africa
items.summary: The attack on the unidentified victim follows a wave of anti-migrants protests in South Africa this year.

items.title: Germany target of 'intensive' espionage, Merz says after suspected Russian spy arrest
items.summary: A Ukrainian man was arrested on suspicion of spying for Russia - one of several such cases in Germany this year.
